national.line: Dogs in costume took over New York City's annual Tompkins Square Halloween Dog Parade.
A Maryland woman bought two identical tickets for the same lottery drawing and won two $50,000 prizes, for a total of $100,000.
A Newfoundland dog's hilarious slow-motion zoomies have people online convinced they're watching a giant bear.
Actor Brendan Fraser surprised fans at a screening of 'The Mummy' by showing up in costume.
A dog was rescued two days after getting lost in an avalanche.
The California Highway Patrol helped wrangle a loose emu that was running in and out of traffic on a Santa Cruz road.
A black cat is 'working overtime' making pumpkin biscuits just in time for Halloween.
A skateboarder from Spain set a Guinness World Record by hitting 94.34 miles per hour racing downhill in Canada.
'It's the Great Pumpkin, Charlie Brown' turns 60 this year, and Upworthy rounded up five little-known facts about the special that changed TV.
A giant pumpkin named Rocky gave a champion grower his California comeback.

local.line: On his very first time snagging, a man from Olathe, Kansas, reeled in a world-record 164-pound paddlefish at Lake of the Ozarks last weekend.
A neighboring church stepped in and built a ramp for a Lebanon woman living with a rare condition called Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome, to make her daily life easier.
Patrick Mahomes' mom has shot down a story claiming the Chiefs star has a home at Lake of the Ozarks.
The City of Lebanon has gone back to the drawing board with another new city logo, paired with a new slogan: 'Build your journey here.'
A cold snap this weekend is expected to bring the Ozarks its coldest morning since last May before mild, dry weather returns next week.
The Camdenton Lakers beat Capital City in a back-and-forth Week 8 football game on a go-ahead touchdown run by Michael Maschino.
Lebanon's Nathaniel Carey has been named the Laclede County Record's Yellowjacket of the Week.
Nearly 2,300 boaters turned out for a sunny Fall Harbor Hop at Lake of the Ozarks.
Details are out on a new 126-room Hyatt hotel planned for Backwater Jacks' Cove at Lake of the Ozarks.
The Lebanon Yellowjackets placed at the Valhalla Marching Festival.
The Orionid meteor shower peaks next Wednesday night with 10 to 20 meteors an hour expected over the Ozarks, though a nearly full moon may wash some out.
A restaurant in Ozark, Missouri, is famous for tossing hot rolls to customers clear across the dining room.
Lake of the Ozarks set a new heat record this past Tuesday.
The Joel E. Barber C-5 School District is considering building a high school addition onto its existing building.
Springfield's September turned out to be hotter than its July.
Springfield's historic Gillioz Theatre is celebrating 100 years of bringing the arts to town.
Camdenton celebrated homecoming with a parade and the crowning of its homecoming royalty.

music.line: Ella Langley, who has the number three song on country radio right now, invited a young fan on stage to sing 'Butterfly Season' with her at the Greek Theater.
Luke Bryan says his new collaboration with Luke Combs, 'Finders Keepers,' checks all the boxes, and he can't wait to work it up with his band.
Morgan Wallen is curating his own 24-hour SiriusXM channel called Morgan Wallen Radio.
Miranda Lambert opened up about the sisterhood she now shares with Lainey Wilson and Ella Langley, saying she never used to have a group of women to call on.
Country singer Riley Green picked Alabama over Tennessee during an appearance on SEC Nation.
Zach Bryan opened up about getting sober in a two-hour conversation with Matthew McConaughey that was posted to YouTube.
Busch Light is turning its cans into hunting trophies, with a duck, a deer and a hog made out of cans for hunting season.
Jason Aldean has been announced as the fourth headliner for the 2027 Carolina Country Music Fest.
Zach Bryan, Megan Moroney and Treaty Oak Revival will headline the GoldenSky Festival's 2027 comeback.
Miley Cyrus paid tribute to Dolly Parton at the Hollywood Bowl.
